title.zh-CN: 持续胸痛伴大汗 · 80岁女性
title.en: Persistent chest pain and sweating · 80-year-old woman

summary.zh-CN: 80岁女性胸痛 6 小时不缓解、大汗淋漓，来到急诊：从最初几分钟的处置，一直跟到住院期间定下的长期用药方案。
summary.en: An 80-year-old woman reaches the emergency department after six hours of unrelieved chest pain and heavy sweating: follow her from the first minutes to the long-term treatment set during her admission.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 根据Ⅱ、Ⅲ、aVF 导联 ST 段抬高及右胸导联（V3R/V4R）ST 段抬高 ≥ 0.05 mV，识别下壁 ST 段抬高型心肌梗死合并右心室受累（第四版心肌梗死通用定义，2018），并且不因高龄推迟、立即启动直接 PCI（ESC 2023 ACS）。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise inferior STEMI with right-ventricular involvement from ST elevation in II, III and aVF with ≥ 0.05 mV in V3R/V4R (Fourth Universal Definition of MI, 2018), and start immediate primary PCI without letting her age delay it (ESC 2023 ACS).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 对右心室受累、收缩压 < 90 mmHg 且双肺清晰的患者，不用硝酸酯（ESC 2023 ACS）、利尿剂和其他扩血管药（中国 STEMI 指南 2019）以及静脉 β 受体阻滞剂，暂停降压药，以小剂量分次补液维持右心室前负荷，每次补液后复评。
learningOutcomes.en: In right-ventricular involvement with a systolic pressure below 90 mmHg and clear lungs, withhold nitrates (ESC 2023 ACS), diuretics and other vasodilators (Chinese STEMI guideline 2019) and IV beta-blockers, hold antihypertensives, and keep the right-ventricular preload up with small fluid boluses, reassessing after each.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 说明为何不再推荐常规血栓抽吸（ESC 2023 ACS Ⅲ类，依据 TASTE 与 TOTAL 研究），以及何时可以选择性抽吸、并在决定是否置入支架之前先行腔内影像检查。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain why routine thrombus aspiration is no longer recommended (ESC 2023 ACS class III, after TASTE and TOTAL) and when selective aspiration, and intravascular imaging before any stent decision, are reasonable.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 依据 Shibata 等（2015）的标准，结合抽吸后管壁光滑、血管内超声未见斑块破裂、未抗凝的心房颤动和左心房内考虑为血栓的回声诊断冠状动脉栓塞，说明血管内超声与经胸超声心动图的局限，并决定不置入支架。
learningOutcomes.en: Diagnose coronary embolism with the Shibata criteria (2015) from a smooth post-aspiration vessel, intravascular ultrasound without plaque rupture, untreated atrial fibrillation and a left atrial echo considered thrombus; state the limits of IVUS and transthoracic echocardiography; and decide against a stent.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 为心房颤动相关的栓塞性心肌梗死制订抗凝方案：计算 CHA₂DS₂-VA 评分，除机械瓣或中重度二尖瓣狭窄外优先选用 DOAC，按说明书依据年龄、体重和肾功能定剂量，如需加用抗血小板药只用一种并限定疗程（ESC 2024 AF）。
learningOutcomes.en: Prescribe anticoagulation after an AF-related embolic infarct: score CHA₂DS₂-VA, choose a DOAC over warfarin unless there is a mechanical valve or moderate–severe mitral stenosis, dose it to the label criteria for age, weight and renal function, and limit any antiplatelet to one agent for a defined period (ESC 2024 AF).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 用通俗语言并配合复述确认，向高龄患者解释她现在为什么需要长期抗凝、这种药与她以前吃的药有什么不同，以及哪些出血表现要立即报告。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain to an older patient in plain words, checked by teach-back, why she now needs long-term anticoagulation, how it differs from the tablets she took before, and which bleeding signs to report at once.

notes.zh-CN: 依据单篇已发表病例报告改编。本版（1.1.0）的患者事实全部沿用 1.0.0 版从报告中提取的内容——80岁女性，高血压 10 年、心房颤动 5 年，服用培哚普利和氨氯地平、未用抗栓药；胸痛 6 小时不缓解，面色苍白、大汗，到院血压 88/62 mmHg、心率 62 次/分，双肺未闻及干湿啰音；Ⅱ、Ⅲ、aVF 导联 ST 段抬高 0.15–0.2 mV、V3R–V5R 抬高 0.1 mV；急诊造影右冠状动脉远段大量血栓、TIMI 1 级，抽吸后管壁光滑无明显狭窄，血管内超声内膜完整、无斑块破裂，未放支架；术后第 3 天超声心动图左心房增大、游离壁回声考虑血栓，下壁和后壁运动减弱，LVEF 55%；肌钙蛋白 I 94.12 μg/L、BNP 3981.2 ng/L、入院 INR 1.1、肌酐 57.3 μmol/L；华法林加过渡期肝素和阿司匹林，第 6 天 INR 2.3 后停肝素；前 10 天有心衰症状，随后改善——尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院和日历日期已去除，时间以相对时间表示。分阶段设计、决策、处置选项、评分、医护角色和患者说出的担忧（教学设定，不增加临床事实）均为教学设计；未记录的内容（心电图节律、其他生命体征、体重、瓣膜、其他冠状动脉、药物剂量、远期结局）保持未知。保留的内部不一致：血栓位于右冠状动脉远段而右胸导联 ST 段抬高；1.0.0 中文写“前 10 天有心衰症状，随后改善并加用相应药物”，英文写“约 10 天”且未提加药。
notes.en: Adapted from a single published case report. Every patient fact in this version (1.1.0) is one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0 — an 80-year-old woman with ten years of hypertension and five of atrial fibrillation, taking perindopril and amlodipine and no antithrombotic; six hours of unrelieved chest pain with pallor and heavy sweating; BP 88/62 mmHg and heart rate 62/min on arrival, lungs without wheeze or crackles; ST elevation of 0.15–0.2 mV in II, III and aVF and 0.1 mV in V3R–V5R; emergency angiography with heavy distal right coronary thrombus and TIMI 1 flow, a smooth vessel without significant stenosis after aspiration, IVUS with an intact intima and no plaque rupture, and no stent; on day 3 after the procedure an enlarged left atrium with a free-wall echo considered thrombus, inferior and posterior hypokinesis and LVEF 55%; troponin I 94.12 μg/L, BNP 3981.2 ng/L, admission INR 1.1 and creatinine 57.3 μmol/L; warfarin with transitional heparin and aspirin, heparin stopped at INR 2.3 on day 6; heart-failure symptoms in the first 10 days, then improvement — and none has yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals and calendar dates are removed and time is relative. The phases, decisions, intervention options, scoring, staff and the patient's voiced worries (teaching devices that add no clinical fact) are teaching design; what is not recorded (the ECG rhythm, other vital signs, weight, valves, the other coronary arteries, drug doses, the long-term outcome) stays unknown. Inconsistencies kept: a distal right coronary thrombus with right-sided ST elevation; 1.0.0's Chinese text says heart-failure symptoms in the first 10 days, then improvement with the corresponding medicines added, while its English says about ten days and omits the medicines.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 胸口痛了 6 个钟头，一直不好
chiefComplaint.en: My chest has hurt for six hours and it won't stop

triageNote.zh-CN: 80岁女性，胸痛 6 小时不缓解，面色苍白、大汗。到院血压 88/62 mmHg，心率 62 次/分。已安置在急诊抢救区。
triageNote.en: 80-year-old woman with six hours of chest pain that has not eased; pale and sweating heavily. On arrival BP 88/62 mmHg, heart rate 62/min. Now in the ED resus bay.

personality.zh-CN: 80岁的老太太，胸口痛了 6 个钟头还没好，又疼又怕。问到什么都尽量回答，话很少；自己清楚的就说，不清楚的就老实说不知道，从不瞎猜。
personality.en: An 80-year-old woman whose chest has hurt for six hours without letup, in pain and frightened. She tries to answer whatever she is asked, in few words; she says what she knows and owns up plainly to what she doesn't, never guessing.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 口语、短句，说话有气无力，不用医学名词；药名只说得出常吃的那两种。
speechStyle.en: Plain, short sentences in a weak voice, no medical words; the only drug names she knows are her two regular tablets.

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生，我胸口一直痛……出了好多汗。
openingLine.en: Doctor, my chest won't stop hurting… and I'm pouring with sweat.

concerns.zh-CN: 是不是心脏出了大毛病？我会不会就这么不行了？
concerns.en: Is it my heart? Am I going to die?

concerns.zh-CN: 要是得吃防血栓的药，是不是一辈子都得吃？会不会哪里出血呀？
concerns.en: If I need a blood thinner, is it for life? Won't it make me bleed?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演者：在急诊她平躺着，脸色发白、满身是汗，疼得说话断断续续，很害怕；到导管室时紧张但清醒，能回答问题；术后第 3 天她最关心以后要吃什么药、会不会出血。只回答被问到的内容；不说任何数字、检查结果或诊断，不编造病史、药物剂量、过敏史或体重。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: in the ED she lies flat, white-faced and drenched in sweat, frightened, speaking in short, broken phrases through the pain; in the catheter laboratory she is tense but awake and can answer; by day 3 after the procedure her worry is which medicines she will need and whether they will make her bleed. She answers only what she is asked, never gives numbers, results or diagnoses, and never invents history, doses, allergies or her weight.

description.zh-CN: 她胸痛已 6 小时仍未缓解，刚到急诊抢救区：采集病史，查体，记录心电图（包括右胸导联），决定再灌注方案和床旁处置。
description.en: Six hours into chest pain that has not eased, she has just reached the ED resus bay: take the history, examine her, record the ECGs (right-sided leads included) and decide on reperfusion and her care at the bedside.

label.zh-CN: 心导管室：急诊冠状动脉造影

description.zh-CN: 她已被送进心导管室，躺在导管床上；急诊冠状动脉造影已经完成，导管室内怎么处理这条血管由你决定。
description.en: She has been brought to the catheter laboratory and lies on the table; the emergency coronary angiogram is done, and how to deal with the artery is yours to decide.

label.zh-CN: 抽吸之后：复查造影与血管内超声
label.en: After aspiration: repeat angiography and intravascular ultrasound

description.zh-CN: 血栓已经抽吸，她仍在导管室：复查造影，用血管内超声查看血管壁，再决定这条血管需不需要支架。
description.en: The thrombus has been aspirated and she is still in the laboratory: repeat the angiogram, look at the vessel wall with intravascular ultrasound, then decide whether the artery needs a stent.

description.zh-CN: 术后第 3 天，她在病房。查阅经胸超声心动图和住院期间的化验，制订长期抗栓方案。
description.en: On day 3 after the procedure she is on the ward. Read the transthoracic echocardiogram and the in-hospital blood results, and set her long-term antithrombotic plan.

description.zh-CN: 查阅本病例记录的治疗经过与结局；远期情况没有记录。
description.en: Review the treatment and outcome as recorded; nothing long-term is recorded.

text.zh-CN: 记录的病程：80岁女性，高血压 10 年、心房颤动 5 年，服用培哚普利和氨氯地平，未用抗栓药。胸痛 6 小时不缓解伴面色苍白、大汗就诊，到院血压 88/62 mmHg、心率 62 次/分，双肺未闻及干湿啰音。心电图Ⅱ、Ⅲ、aVF 导联 ST 段抬高 0.15–0.2 mV，V3R–V5R 导联抬高 0.1 mV；入院 INR 1.1，肌酐 57.3 μmol/L。急诊冠状动脉造影见右冠状动脉远段大量血栓、TIMI 血流 1 级；血栓抽吸后管壁光滑、无明显狭窄，血管内超声示内膜完整、无斑块破裂，未置入支架。肌钙蛋白 I 94.12 μg/L（参考 0–0.04），BNP 3981.2 ng/L（两者采血时间未记录）。术后第 3 天超声心动图：左心房增大，游离壁回声考虑血栓，下壁、后壁运动减弱，LVEF 55%。治疗：华法林加过渡期肝素，并用阿司匹林；第 6 天 INR 达 2.3 后停用肝素。前 10 天有心衰症状，随后好转，并加用了相应药物（药名未记录）。报告题目将本例归为心房颤动患者左心房血栓脱落所致急性心肌梗死；栓子脱落和迁移的过程没有被直接观察到。本病例没有记录药物剂量、INR 目标、阿司匹林疗程、出院方案，以及远期栓塞和出血结局。
text.en: Recorded course: an 80-year-old woman with ten years of hypertension and five of atrial fibrillation, taking perindopril and amlodipine and no antithrombotic, presented after six hours of unrelieved chest pain with pallor and heavy sweating; on arrival BP 88/62 mmHg, heart rate 62/min, lungs without wheeze or crackles. ECG: ST elevation of 0.15–0.2 mV in II, III and aVF and 0.1 mV in V3R–V5R; admission INR 1.1, creatinine 57.3 μmol/L. Emergency angiography showed heavy thrombus in the distal right coronary artery with TIMI 1 flow; after thrombus aspiration the vessel wall was smooth without significant stenosis, IVUS showed an intact intima without plaque rupture, and no stent was placed. Troponin I 94.12 μg/L (reference 0–0.04) and BNP 3981.2 ng/L (sampling times not recorded). Echocardiogram on day 3 after the procedure: enlarged left atrium with a free-wall echo considered thrombus, inferior and posterior hypokinesis, LVEF 55%. Treatment: warfarin with heparin during the transition, and aspirin; heparin was stopped on day 6 once the INR reached 2.3. Heart-failure symptoms during the first 10 days then improved, with the corresponding medicines added (not named). The report's title attributes the infarct to dislodged left atrial thrombus in AF; the embolus's dislodgement and migration were not directly observed. This case does not record the drug doses, the INR target, how long aspirin was given, the discharge regimen, or later embolic and bleeding outcomes.

dose.zh-CN: 床旁监护仪持续监测心电、无创血压和血氧饱和度；除颤仪推到床旁并贴好电极片，阿托品和经皮起搏备用。
dose.en: Continuous ECG, non-invasive blood pressure and SpO₂ on the bedside monitor; the defibrillator at the bedside with pads applied, atropine and transcutaneous pacing ready.

response.zh-CN: 监护已接上，电极片已贴好。本病例没有记录她的监护读数和心律，也不模拟。
response.en: The monitor is connected and the pads are on. Her monitor readings and rhythm are not recorded in this case and are not simulated.

name.zh-CN: 建立静脉通路并抽血送检

dose.zh-CN: 外周静脉留置针，尽量放在左上肢、把右手腕留给桡动脉入路；同时抽血送检。
dose.en: A peripheral cannula — in the left arm if possible, keeping the right wrist free for radial access — with blood drawn at the same time.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 阿司匹林 150–300 mg 嚼服（非肠溶片）；不能吞服时 75–250 mg 静脉注射。
dose.en: Aspirin 150–300 mg chewed (non-enteric-coated); 75–250 mg IV if she cannot swallow.

response.zh-CN: 阿司匹林已嚼服。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Aspirin chewed. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 氯吡格雷 300–600 mg 口服负荷，之后 75 mg 每日一次；预计需要口服抗凝时，P2Y12 受体抑制剂首选氯吡格雷。
dose.en: Clopidogrel 300–600 mg orally as a loading dose, then 75 mg once daily; when oral anticoagulation is foreseeable, clopidogrel is the P2Y12 inhibitor of choice.

response.zh-CN: 已给负荷量。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Loading dose given. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 普通肝素静脉推注（PCI 抗凝）
name.en: Unfractionated heparin IV bolus for PCI

dose.zh-CN: PCI 开始时普通肝素 70–100 U/kg 静脉推注（拟用 GP IIb/IIIa 受体拮抗剂时 50–70 U/kg），术中按活化凝血时间追加。
dose.en: UFH 70–100 U/kg as an IV bolus at the start of PCI (50–70 U/kg if a GP IIb/IIIa inhibitor will be used), topped up in the laboratory by the activated clotting time.

response.zh-CN: 肝素已推注。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Heparin given. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 启动心导管室（直接 PCI）
name.en: Activate the catheter laboratory for primary PCI

dose.zh-CN: 一个电话启动：通知介入心内科医生和导管室团队，准备立即冠状动脉造影并按需 PCI。
dose.en: A single activation call to the interventional cardiologist and catheter-laboratory team for immediate coronary angiography and PCI as needed.

response.zh-CN: 介入团队已接到呼叫，导管室正在准备。本病例没有记录从到院到进入导管室的时间；接下来的记录按实际病程展开。
response.en: The interventional team has been called and the laboratory is getting ready. This case does not record the time from arrival to the laboratory; the records that follow show the course as it happened.

name.zh-CN: 带监护和除颤仪转运至导管室
name.en: Transfer to the catheter laboratory on the monitor

en: take her to the cath lab

dose.zh-CN: 医生和护士陪同，带监护仪、除颤仪和急救药品转运，到导管室后完成交接。
dose.en: Doctor- and nurse-escorted transfer with the monitor, defibrillator and emergency drugs, with a handover on arrival in the laboratory.

harm.zh-CN: 转运前先启动导管室：没有启动电话，导管室里就没有团队在等，低血压的患者只能在门口耽搁。
harm.en: Activate the laboratory before the transfer: without the activation call no team is waiting, and a hypotensive patient is left at the door.

response.zh-CN: 她已在医护陪同下送进导管室，并完成交接。
response.en: She has been taken to the catheter laboratory with an escort, and the handover is done.

name.zh-CN: 小剂量分次补液（晶体液）

dose.zh-CN: 0.9% 氯化钠小剂量分次静脉快速输注（常用每次 250–500 mL），每次后复查血压、外周灌注和肺部听诊；出现肺部湿啰音或气促即停止。
dose.en: 0.9 % sodium chloride in small rapid IV boluses (commonly 250–500 mL each), reassessing blood pressure, perfusion and the lung bases after each; stop if crackles or breathlessness appear.

response.zh-CN: 补液已开始。本病例没有记录是否补过液，也没有记录之后的血压；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The bolus is running. This case does not record whether fluid was given or her later blood pressure; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 暂停培哚普利和氨氯地平

dose.zh-CN: 低血压期间暂停全部降压药；血压恢复、病情稳定后再评估何时重新使用。
dose.en: Hold all blood-pressure medicines while she is hypotensive; decide when to restart once her pressure has recovered and she is stable.

response.zh-CN: 两种药都已在医嘱上暂停。本病例没有记录这一步，也没有记录何时恢复用药；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Both are held on the drug chart. This case does not record this step or when they were restarted; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 硝酸甘油 0.4–0.5 mg 舌下含服，必要时每 5 分钟重复，最多 3 次；只用于收缩压 ≥ 90 mmHg、无右心室梗死、近期未用磷酸二酯酶-5 抑制剂者。
dose.en: GTN 0.4–0.5 mg sublingually, repeated every 5 minutes up to 3 doses — only with a systolic pressure of at least 90 mmHg, no right-ventricular infarction and no recent phosphodiesterase-5 inhibitor.

harm.zh-CN: 她到院收缩压 88 mmHg，硝酸酯属于禁忌（ESC 2023 ACS）。下壁心肌梗死常累及右心室，右心室靠前负荷维持输出，硝酸酯扩张静脉、减少回心血量，可使血压骤然大幅下降——用任何扩血管药之前先记录 V3R/V4R。硝酸酯只缓解症状，不能开通闭塞的血管。本病例此后没有记录血压，没有哪个时点能证明用药已经安全。
harm.en: Her arrival systolic pressure was 88 mmHg, which rules out a nitrate (ESC 2023 ACS). Inferior infarction often involves the right ventricle, whose output depends on preload; a nitrate's venodilation can drop the pressure suddenly and steeply — record V3R/V4R before any vasodilator. Nitrates ease symptoms; they do not open the artery. No later blood pressure is recorded in this case, so no point is documented at which it became safe.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录是否用过硝酸酯；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case does not record whether a nitrate was given; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 呋塞米 20–40 mg 静脉注射，按反应调整。
dose.en: Furosemide 20–40 mg IV, adjusted to the response.

harm.zh-CN: 收缩压 88 mmHg 的下壁心肌梗死可能累及右心室；右心室梗死要维持有效的右心室前负荷、避免利尿剂和血管扩张剂（中国 STEMI 指南 2019），利尿只会进一步降低血压。利尿剂用于查体发现的容量负荷过重，而不是按年龄预判的心力衰竭。
harm.en: In an inferior infarct with a systolic pressure of 88 mmHg the right ventricle may be involved; right-ventricular infarction calls for keeping its preload up and avoiding diuretics and vasodilators (Chinese STEMI guideline 2019), and a diuretic would only push the pressure lower. Diuretics are for volume overload found on examination, not for heart failure expected at her age.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录这一阶段是否用过利尿剂；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case does not record whether a diuretic was given at this stage; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 美托洛尔 5 mg 静脉注射，间隔 2 分钟可重复，最多 3 次。
dose.en: Metoprolol 5 mg IV, repeatable at 2-minute intervals up to 3 doses.

harm.zh-CN: ESC 2023 ACS 只在没有低血压、没有急性心力衰竭的直接 PCI 患者中考虑就诊时静脉使用 β 受体阻滞剂。她到院收缩压 88 mmHg、心率 62 次/分；下壁梗死多在右冠状动脉供血区，可伴心动过缓和房室传导阻滞，静脉 β 受体阻滞剂会同时加重低血压和心动过缓。
harm.en: ESC 2023 ACS considers IV beta-blockers at presentation only for primary-PCI patients without hypotension or acute heart failure. Her arrival pressure was 88 mmHg with a rate of 62/min, and an inferior infarct — usually right-coronary territory — can bring bradycardia and AV block, which IV beta-blockade deepens along with the hypotension.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录是否用过 β 受体阻滞剂；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case does not record whether a beta-blocker was given; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 替奈普酶按体重分档单次静脉推注。
dose.en: Tenecteplase as a single weight-banded IV bolus.

harm.zh-CN: 本院有心导管室：能在诊断后 120 分钟内完成直接 PCI 时，直接 PCI 优于溶栓（ESC 2023 ACS），溶栓留给不能及时 PCI 的情况。她 80 岁，出血史和卒中史都不清楚，溶栓只增加颅内和全身出血的风险，却换不来额外获益。
harm.en: This hospital has a catheter laboratory: when primary PCI can be done within 120 minutes of diagnosis it is preferred to fibrinolysis (ESC 2023 ACS), which is kept for when timely PCI is not possible. At 80, with her bleeding and stroke history unknown, a lytic adds intracranial and systemic bleeding risk for no extra benefit.

response.zh-CN: 溶栓药已推注。本病例没有记录溶栓；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The lytic has been given. This case records no fibrinolysis; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 导丝通过后经抽吸导管手动抽吸血栓——针对大量残余血栓的选择性措施，而不是每例常规。
dose.en: Once the wire is across, manual aspiration through an aspiration catheter — a selective step for a heavy thrombus burden, not a routine one.

response.zh-CN: 血栓已抽吸。抽吸后的复查造影和血管内超声见下一阶段的记录。
response.en: The thrombus has been aspirated. The repeat angiogram and intravascular ultrasound that followed are in the next records.

dose.zh-CN: 球囊预扩张后按造影测量置入药物洗脱支架。
dose.en: Balloon pre-dilatation, then a drug-eluting stent sized from the angiogram.

harm.zh-CN: 在血栓清除、腔内影像证实确有需要处理的病变之前放支架，等于为一个没人看到的病变留下永久植入物。她有房颤，CHA₂DS₂-VA 评分至少 3 分，本就符合抗凝指征（ESC 2024 AF）；支架会带来数月抗凝加抗血小板的联合治疗，80 岁时出血风险明显增加（ESC 2023 ACS）。是否放支架，要等影像显示确有需要处理的病变再定。
harm.en: A stent placed before the thrombus is cleared and intravascular imaging has shown a lesion that needs one leaves a permanent implant for a lesion nobody has seen. With AF and a CHA₂DS₂-VA score of at least 3 she already qualifies for anticoagulation (ESC 2024 AF), and a stent adds months of combined anticoagulant and antiplatelet therapy with a markedly higher bleeding risk at 80 (ESC 2023 ACS). Decide on a stent only once imaging shows a lesion that needs one.

response.zh-CN: 本病例不模拟这一步的效果；接下来的记录按实际病程展开。
response.en: This case does not simulate the effect of this step; the records that follow show the course as it happened.

dose.zh-CN: 以阿哌沙班为例：5 mg 每日 2 次；仅在年龄 ≥ 80 岁、体重 ≤ 60 kg、血肌酐 ≥ 133 μmol/L 三项中至少满足两项时减为 2.5 mg 每日 2 次。其他 DOAC 按说明书依据年龄、体重和肌酐清除率给药，不超说明书减量；机械瓣或中重度二尖瓣狭窄者不用。
dose.en: Apixaban, for example: 5 mg twice daily, reduced to 2.5 mg twice daily only when at least two of age ≥ 80 years, weight ≤ 60 kg and serum creatinine ≥ 133 μmol/L apply. Other DOACs at their label dose for age, weight and creatinine clearance, with no off-label reduction; not with a mechanical valve or moderate–severe mitral stenosis.

response.zh-CN: 已开具。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。定剂量前先核对体重和肾功能——她的体重没有记录。
response.en: Prescribed. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect. Check her weight and renal function for the dose — her weight is not recorded.

name.zh-CN: 华法林，并以肝素过渡至 INR 达标
name.en: Warfarin with heparin until the INR is in range

dose.zh-CN: 华法林每日口服，按 INR 调整剂量，目标 INR 2.0–3.0；同时使用肝素（普通肝素或低分子肝素），直到 INR 达标后停用。
dose.en: Warfarin daily, dose-adjusted to an INR of 2.0–3.0, with heparin (unfractionated or low-molecular-weight) alongside until the INR is in range.

response.zh-CN: 已开具华法林并以肝素过渡。本病例不模拟其效果；记录中实际使用的药物见结局记录。
response.en: Warfarin prescribed with heparin cover until the INR is in range. This case does not simulate its effect; the medicines actually given are in the outcome record.

name.zh-CN: 以阿司匹林加氯吡格雷代替抗凝
name.en: Aspirin plus clopidogrel instead of an anticoagulant

dose.zh-CN: 阿司匹林 75–100 mg 每日一次加氯吡格雷 75 mg 每日一次，不用口服抗凝药。
dose.en: Aspirin 75–100 mg once daily plus clopidogrel 75 mg once daily, with no oral anticoagulant.

harm.zh-CN: 抗血小板治疗不能替代房颤的抗凝：ACTIVE W 研究中，阿司匹林加氯吡格雷预防血管事件的效果不如口服抗凝，大出血并不更少；ESC 2024 AF 不推荐以抗血小板药代替抗凝（Ⅲ类）。房颤、高血压、80 岁，她的 CHA₂DS₂-VA 评分至少 3 分，无论这次住院还发现什么，都已达到抗凝标准。
harm.en: Antiplatelets are no substitute for anticoagulation in AF: in ACTIVE W, aspirin plus clopidogrel prevented fewer vascular events than oral anticoagulation, with no less major bleeding, and ESC 2024 AF advises against antiplatelets as an alternative (class III). With AF, hypertension and age 80 her CHA₂DS₂-VA score is at least 3 — she meets the threshold for anticoagulation whatever else this admission shows.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录这一方案；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case does not record this regimen; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 口服抗凝药加阿司匹林和氯吡格雷，持续 12 个月
name.en: Oral anticoagulant plus aspirin and clopidogrel for 12 months

dose.zh-CN: 口服抗凝药 + 阿司匹林 75–100 mg 每日一次 + 氯吡格雷 75 mg 每日一次，共 12 个月。
dose.en: An oral anticoagulant plus aspirin 75–100 mg daily and clopidogrel 75 mg daily for 12 months.

harm.zh-CN: 即使置入了支架，房颤合并 ACS 的默认方案也只是至多 1 周的三联治疗，之后口服抗凝药加一种 P2Y12 受体抑制剂（首选氯吡格雷）最多 12 个月，再改为单用抗凝（ESC 2023 ACS；ESC 2024 AF）。80 岁患者用 12 个月三联治疗，大出血风险会高得多。
harm.en: Even after a stent, the default for AF with ACS is triple therapy for no more than a week, then an oral anticoagulant with one P2Y12 inhibitor (preferably clopidogrel) for up to 12 months, then the anticoagulant alone (ESC 2023 ACS; ESC 2024 AF). Twelve months of triple therapy at 80 would expose her to a much higher risk of major bleeding.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录这一方案；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case does not record this regimen; it does not simulate its effect.

title.zh-CN: 了解这次胸痛和她的用药
title.en: Hear the story: the pain, her illnesses and her medicines

hint.zh-CN: 要判断有多紧急，这次胸痛你还需要问清什么？她有哪些慢性病、平时吃什么药——又有什么药没有吃？
hint.en: Before you judge how urgent this is, what else do you need to know about the pain? Which long-term conditions does she have, which medicines does she take — and which does she not?

guidance.zh-CN: 到床旁问清胸痛何时开始、现在是否仍在痛、伴随哪些不适，以及她的慢性病和平时用药（包括有没有吃防血栓的药）。
guidance.en: At the bedside, ask when the pain began, whether it is still there and what came with it, and about her long-term conditions and regular medicines — blood thinners included.

title.zh-CN: 查体、记录心电图并送检血标本
title.en: Examine her, record the ECGs and send the bloods

hint.zh-CN: 读完 12 导联心电图，你还想加做哪些导联？她的血压和双肺告诉你什么？哪些结果不必等到出来再行动？
hint.en: Once you have read the 12-lead ECG, which other leads do you want? What do her blood pressure and lungs tell you — and which results need not hold you up?

guidance.zh-CN: 测生命体征、望诊、听诊双肺；推来心电图机记录 12 导联心电图和右胸导联；放置留置针时抽血送检凝血和肾功能，然后到会诊板作答决策 1。
guidance.en: Take her vital signs, look at her and listen to her lungs; bring the ECG machine for a 12-lead ECG and the right-sided leads; send clotting and renal bloods with the cannula, then answer decision 1 on the case board.

title.zh-CN: 定下急诊处置并付诸行动
title.en: Decide her care in the ED and act on it

hint.zh-CN: 血压这么低、梗死又在下壁：哪些常用的胸痛药现在可能伤害她？导管室准备期间，她床边需要什么？
hint.en: With a pressure this low and an inferior infarct, which of the usual chest-pain drugs could harm her now? What does she need at her bedside while the laboratory gets ready?

guidance.zh-CN: 在会诊板作答决策 2，把计划落实到床旁——监护、用药、补液——并打电话启动导管室；导管室准备好后，由你安排转运。
guidance.en: Answer decision 2 on the case board and carry the plan out at the bedside — monitoring, medicines, fluid — and make the call that activates the catheter laboratory; once it is ready, you arrange the transfer.

title.zh-CN: 在导管室决定怎样处理这条血管
title.en: Decide how to deal with the artery in the catheter laboratory

hint.zh-CN: 造影上血栓有多少、血流几级？在决定放不放支架之前，你需要先知道血栓下面是什么吗？
hint.en: How much thrombus is there, and what is the flow? Before deciding on a stent, do you need to know what lies beneath the thrombus?

guidance.zh-CN: 在导管室阅读冠状动脉造影，在会诊板作答决策 3，然后实施你选择的导管室操作。
guidance.en: Read the coronary angiogram in the laboratory, answer decision 3 on the case board, then carry out the step you chose.

title.zh-CN: 看清血栓下面的血管，决定要不要支架
title.en: See the artery beneath the thrombus and decide on a stent

hint.zh-CN: 现在管腔和血管壁是什么样？如果血管壁本身没有问题，血栓还可能从哪里来？
hint.en: What do the lumen and the vessel wall look like now? If the wall itself is sound, where else could the thrombus have come from?

guidance.zh-CN: 复查造影、做血管内超声，然后在会诊板作答决策 4。
guidance.en: Repeat the angiogram and look with intravascular ultrasound, then answer decision 4 on the case board.

title.zh-CN: 术后第 3 天：定下长期方案并查阅结局
title.en: Day 3: set the long-term plan and review the outcome

hint.zh-CN: 超声心动图支持你对血栓来源的判断吗？哪些信息决定药物的选择和剂量，哪些还缺？她自己最担心什么？
hint.en: Does the echocardiogram support your view of where the thrombus came from? Which facts decide the choice of drug and its dose, and which are still missing? What worries her most?

guidance.zh-CN: 问她这几天怎么样，做经胸超声心动图，查阅住院期间的肌钙蛋白和 BNP，在会诊板作答决策 5 并开出你的抗栓方案；之后在病历终端查阅记录的病程与结局。
guidance.en: Ask how she has been, get the transthoracic echo, read the in-hospital troponin and BNP, answer decision 5 and prescribe your antithrombotic plan; then read the recorded course and outcome at a records terminal.

prompt.zh-CN: 80岁女性，胸痛 6 小时仍未缓解，面色苍白、大汗；到院血压 88/62 mmHg，心率 62 次/分。12 导联心电图：Ⅱ、Ⅲ、aVF 导联 ST 段抬高 0.15–0.2 mV。本院设有心导管室。你的再灌注计划是什么？
prompt.en: An 80-year-old woman with six hours of unrelieved chest pain, pale and sweating; on arrival BP 88/62 mmHg, heart rate 62/min. Her 12-lead ECG shows ST elevation of 0.15–0.2 mV in II, III and aVF. This hospital has a catheter laboratory. What is your reperfusion plan?

need.zh-CN: 先问清胸痛何时开始、现在是否仍在痛，测量生命体征，并记录、阅读 12 导联心电图。
need.en: First establish when the pain began and whether it is still there, take her vital signs, and record and read the 12-lead ECG.

text.zh-CN: 下壁 ST 段抬高型心肌梗死，发病在 12 小时以内：立即启动导管室行直接 PCI，年龄不是推迟的理由，也不等肌钙蛋白结果
text.en: Inferior STEMI within 12 hours of onset: activate the catheter laboratory for immediate primary PCI — her age is no reason to delay, and no troponin result is awaited

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。持续缺血症状伴相邻导联 ST 段抬高、发病 12 小时以内，能在诊断后 120 分钟内完成 PCI 时首选直接 PCI（ESC 2023 ACS）；再灌注决定不等待心肌标志物，高龄本身也不是禁忌。中国 STEMI 指南（2019）同样要求尽早再灌注。
feedback.en: Correct. Ongoing ischaemic symptoms with ST elevation in contiguous leads within 12 hours of onset call for primary PCI when it can be done within 120 minutes of diagnosis (ESC 2023 ACS); the decision does not wait for cardiac markers, and age alone is no contraindication. The Chinese STEMI guideline (2019) likewise asks for reperfusion as early as possible.

text.zh-CN: 先查高敏肌钙蛋白，升高后再启动导管室：高龄患者的心电图常常不典型，单凭这一份心电图就贸然行动，可能让她白白承受一次有创检查
text.en: High-sensitivity troponin first, activating the laboratory only if it is raised: ECGs in older patients are often atypical, and acting on this tracing alone may put her through an invasive test for nothing

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。0 小时/1 小时肌钙蛋白方案用于心电图不能诊断时排除或确诊非 ST 段抬高心肌梗死；对持续胸痛伴 ST 段抬高的患者，ESC 2023 ACS 不让再灌注等待肌钙蛋白。等待的每一段时间都在损失心肌。
feedback.en: No. The 0 h/1 h troponin algorithm rules NSTEMI in or out when the ECG is not diagnostic; with ongoing pain and ST elevation, ESC 2023 ACS does not let reperfusion wait for troponin. Every minute of waiting costs myocardium.

text.zh-CN: 立即静脉溶栓：溶栓几分钟内就能开始，比等导管室团队集结更快，而发病 6 小时仍在溶栓获益明显的时间窗内
text.en: Fibrinolysis now: a lytic can start within minutes, sooner than the catheter team can assemble, and six hours from onset is still well inside the window where it helps

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。能在诊断后 120 分钟内完成直接 PCI 时，直接 PCI 优于溶栓（ESC 2023 ACS），而本院有心导管室。她 80 岁，出血史和卒中史不明，溶栓只增加颅内出血风险，得不到额外获益。
feedback.en: No. When primary PCI can be done within 120 minutes of diagnosis it is preferred to fibrinolysis (ESC 2023 ACS), and this hospital has a catheter laboratory. At 80, with her bleeding and stroke history unknown, a lytic adds intracranial bleeding risk for no extra benefit.

text.zh-CN: 先做主动脉 CT 血管成像：下壁 ST 段抬高合并低血压，必须先排除累及右冠状动脉开口的主动脉夹层，再给任何抗栓药物
text.en: A CT aortogram first: inferior ST elevation with hypotension means an aortic dissection involving the right coronary ostium must be excluded before any antithrombotic is given

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。主动脉夹层确可累及右冠状动脉开口，但需要临床线索——撕裂样胸背痛、双上肢血压或脉搏不对称、神经系统体征、纵隔增宽——本病例没有记录这些表现。没有线索时常规先做 CT 只会推迟再灌注（ESC 2023 ACS）。
feedback.en: No. Dissection can involve the right coronary ostium, but it needs clinical clues — tearing pain into the back, a pulse or pressure difference between the arms, neurological signs, a widened mediastinum — and none is recorded here. Without them a routine CT only delays reperfusion (ESC 2023 ACS).

text.zh-CN: 收入 CCU 先药物治疗，等血压回升、病情稳定后，在 24 小时内再行冠状动脉造影
text.en: Admit to the CCU for medical treatment first and perform angiography within 24 hours, once her blood pressure has recovered and she is stable

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。等血压回升再造影，恰恰让最需要尽快开通血管的患者等在危险里：低血压的下壁 ST 段抬高型心肌梗死应立即行直接 PCI，24 小时内的早期侵入策略是为病情稳定的非 ST 段抬高 ACS 准备的（ESC 2023 ACS）。
feedback.en: No. Waiting for the pressure to recover keeps the patient who most needs an open artery waiting in danger: a hypotensive inferior STEMI needs immediate primary PCI, while an early invasive strategy within 24 hours is meant for stable NSTE-ACS (ESC 2023 ACS).

prompt.zh-CN: 右胸导联 V3R–V5R ST 段抬高 0.1 mV；血压 88/62 mmHg，双肺未闻及干、湿啰音。导管室正在准备。护士准备给她舌下含服硝酸甘油止痛，并问要不要照常给她吃培哚普利和氨氯地平。你怎么处理？
prompt.en: The right-sided leads show ST elevation of 0.1 mV in V3R–V5R; her BP is 88/62 mmHg and there are no wheezes or crackles over her lungs. The catheter laboratory is getting ready. The nurse is about to give sublingual GTN for the pain and asks whether to give her usual perindopril and amlodipine. What do you do?

need.zh-CN: 先作答决策 1，记录并阅读右胸导联，听诊双肺，并问清她平时吃的药。
need.en: First answer decision 1, record and read the right-sided leads, listen to her lungs and find out which medicines she takes.

text.zh-CN: 右心室受累合并低血压、双肺清晰：不用硝酸酯，暂停培哚普利和氨氯地平，小剂量分次补液并复评，贴好除颤电极、备好阿托品和起搏
text.en: Right-ventricular involvement with hypotension and clear lungs: no nitrate, hold the perindopril and amlodipine, give small fluid boluses with reassessment, and keep pads on with atropine and pacing ready

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。V3R/V4R 导联 ST 段抬高 ≥ 0.05 mV 支持右心室梗死（第四版心肌梗死通用定义，2018）。低血压或右心室梗死时不用硝酸酯（ESC 2023 ACS）；右心室梗死要维持有效的右心室前负荷，避免利尿剂和扩血管药（中国 STEMI 指南 2019），双肺清晰时可分次补液、每次复评。下壁梗死易伴心动过缓和房室传导阻滞，需持续监护并备好处理。
feedback.en: Correct. ST elevation of ≥ 0.05 mV in V3R/V4R supports right-ventricular infarction (Fourth Universal Definition of MI, 2018). Nitrates are withheld with hypotension or RV infarction (ESC 2023 ACS); RV infarction calls for keeping its preload up and avoiding diuretics and vasodilators (Chinese STEMI guideline 2019), so with clear lungs give fluid in small boluses, reassessing each time. Inferior infarcts often bring bradycardia and AV block, so keep her monitored with treatment ready.

text.zh-CN: 先舌下含服硝酸甘油止痛，不缓解再静脉用吗啡；培哚普利和氨氯地平照常服用，以免撤药后血压反跳
text.en: Sublingual GTN for the pain first, IV morphine if that fails, and her perindopril and amlodipine as usual so that her pressure does not rebound off them

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。低血压和右心室梗死都是硝酸酯的禁忌（ESC 2023 ACS）：静脉扩张会让依赖前负荷的右心室输出骤降。吗啡同样扩张血管、可加重低血压，还会延缓口服 P2Y12 受体抑制剂的吸收；低血压时照常服降压药只会雪上加霜。
feedback.en: No. Hypotension and right-ventricular infarction both rule out nitrates (ESC 2023 ACS): venodilation drops the output of a preload-dependent right ventricle. Morphine also dilates vessels and can deepen hypotension, and it slows the absorption of oral P2Y12 inhibitors; her usual antihypertensives would only add to the fall.

text.zh-CN: 静脉推注呋塞米：80 岁的心肌梗死患者很快会出现心力衰竭，提前利尿可以预防肺水肿；降压药先全部停掉，等血压回升以后再恢复服用
text.en: IV furosemide now: an 80-year-old with an infarct will soon be in heart failure, and diuresis ahead of time prevents pulmonary oedema; stop her antihypertensives for now and restart them once the pressure recovers

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。她双肺清晰，没有需要利尿的淤血；右心室梗死要维持前负荷、避免利尿剂（中国 STEMI 指南 2019），低血压时利尿只会让血压更低。利尿剂用来处理已经出现的容量负荷过重，而不是按年龄预防心力衰竭。
feedback.en: No. Her lungs are clear, so there is no congestion to offload; RV infarction calls for preserving preload and avoiding diuretics (Chinese STEMI guideline 2019), and diuresis in hypotension only drives the pressure lower. Diuretics treat volume overload that is present, not heart failure anticipated from age.

text.zh-CN: 静脉注射美托洛尔以缩小梗死面积，因血压偏低同时暂停培哚普利和氨氯地平，然后联系导管室
text.en: IV metoprolol to limit the infarct size, holding the perindopril and amlodipine because of the low pressure, then call the laboratory

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。ESC 2023 ACS 只在没有低血压、没有急性心力衰竭的直接 PCI 患者中考虑就诊时静脉使用 β 受体阻滞剂。她收缩压 88 mmHg、心率 62 次/分，下壁梗死还可能出现房室传导阻滞，静脉 β 受体阻滞剂会加重低血压和心动过缓。暂停降压药这一点是对的。
feedback.en: No. ESC 2023 ACS considers IV beta-blockers at presentation only for primary-PCI patients without hypotension or acute heart failure. At 88 mmHg and 62/min, with an inferior infarct that can bring AV block, IV beta-blockade deepens both hypotension and bradycardia. Holding the antihypertensives is right.

text.zh-CN: 立即泵入去甲肾上腺素升压，一点液体都不补：80 岁老人一补液就容易肺水肿，升压药更安全
text.en: Start a noradrenaline infusion at once and give no fluid at all: fluid at 80 brings on pulmonary oedema, and a pressor is safer

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。右心室梗死的低血压首先要维持右心室前负荷（中国 STEMI 指南 2019）：双肺清晰时分次补液、每次复评；补液后血压仍低才加用正性肌力药或缩血管药，同时尽快再灌注。年龄本身不是拒绝补液的理由，关键在于每次补液后复查肺部和灌注。
feedback.en: No. Hypotension in RV infarction is first a matter of keeping the right-ventricular preload up (Chinese STEMI guideline 2019): with clear lungs, small boluses with reassessment; inotropes or vasopressors come if the pressure stays low, alongside prompt reperfusion. Age alone is no reason to withhold fluid — what matters is rechecking the lungs and perfusion after each bolus.

prompt.zh-CN: 急诊冠状动脉造影：右冠状动脉远段大量血栓，TIMI 血流 1 级。你在导管室怎么处理这条血管？
prompt.en: Emergency angiography shows heavy thrombus in the distal right coronary artery with TIMI 1 flow. How do you deal with this artery in the laboratory?

need.zh-CN: 先在导管室阅读冠状动脉造影。
need.en: First read the coronary angiogram in the laboratory.

text.zh-CN: 导丝通过后，针对这处大量血栓选择性手动抽吸，再用腔内影像（IVUS 或 OCT）看清血管壁，之后才决定要不要放支架
text.en: Once the wire is across, aspirate this heavy thrombus selectively, then image the vessel wall (IVUS or OCT) before deciding whether any stent is needed

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。常规血栓抽吸已不推荐（ESC 2023 ACS Ⅲ类，A 级，依据 TASTE 与 TOTAL 研究），但导丝通过后仍有大量血栓时，选择性抽吸仍有其位置。抽吸后用腔内影像判断血栓下面有没有需要处理的病变；对不确定的罪犯病变，ESC 2023 ACS 建议考虑腔内影像，首选 OCT。记录中正是抽吸后行 IVUS。
feedback.en: Correct. Routine thrombus aspiration is no longer recommended (ESC 2023 ACS class III, level A, after TASTE and TOTAL), but selective aspiration keeps a place when a heavy thrombus burden remains once the wire is across. Imaging then shows whether a lesion beneath needs treating; for an ambiguous culprit, ESC 2023 ACS suggests intravascular imaging, preferably OCT. The record shows aspiration followed by IVUS.

text.zh-CN: 球囊预扩张后，立即在血栓所在节段置入一枚药物洗脱支架：先恢复血流最要紧，支架还能把残余血栓压在血管壁上、防止血管再次闭塞
text.en: Pre-dilate and deploy a drug-eluting stent across the thrombus straight away: restoring flow comes first, and the stent pins any leftover thrombus against the wall

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。在大量血栓上直接扩张、置入支架，容易把血栓冲向远端造成无复流；看清血管壁之前，你并不知道血栓下面有没有需要支架的病变。她有房颤，日后需要抗凝，一枚不必要的支架会带来数月的联合抗栓治疗（ESC 2023 ACS；ESC 2024 AF）。
feedback.en: No. Ballooning and stenting through heavy thrombus risks washing it downstream into no-reflow, and until you have seen the wall you do not know whether there is any lesion that needs a stent. With AF she will need anticoagulation, and an unnecessary stent adds months of combined antithrombotic therapy (ESC 2023 ACS; ESC 2024 AF).

text.zh-CN: 先抽吸，因为血栓抽吸是每例直接 PCI 的标准第一步；抽吸后在原来有血栓的节段置入支架
text.en: Aspirate first, because thrombus aspiration is the standard first step of every primary PCI, then stent the segment that held the thrombus

feedback.zh-CN: 不对，尽管这里抽吸本身没有错。ESC 2012 STEMI 指南曾把常规抽吸列为Ⅱa 类，但 TASTE（2013）和 TOTAL（2015）研究没有显示获益，TOTAL 中 30 天卒中更多；ESC 2023 ACS 现将常规抽吸列为Ⅲ类。不经影像评估就在该节段放支架，可能是给一段正常的血管放了支架。
feedback.en: No, though aspirating here is not itself wrong. ESC 2012 STEMI rated routine aspiration class IIa, but TASTE (2013) and TOTAL (2015) showed no benefit, with more strokes at 30 days in TOTAL, and ESC 2023 ACS now rates routine aspiration class III. Stenting the segment without imaging it may mean stenting a normal artery.

text.zh-CN: 导丝暂不通过：给予肝素加糖蛋白 IIb/IIIa 受体拮抗剂，48 小时后等血栓溶解再复查造影
text.en: Do not cross yet: give heparin with a glycoprotein IIb/IIIa inhibitor and repeat the angiogram in 48 hours, once the thrombus has dissolved

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。她仍是 TIMI 1 级血流、低血压的急性下壁心肌梗死，拖延开通只会让更多心肌坏死；直接 PCI 的意义就在于现在开通血管（ESC 2023 ACS）。糖蛋白 IIb/IIIa 受体拮抗剂留作无复流或血栓并发症时的补救，80 岁时出血风险尤其高。
feedback.en: No. With TIMI 1 flow and hypotension in an acute inferior infarct, every hour of delay lets more muscle die; primary PCI means opening the artery now (ESC 2023 ACS). GP IIb/IIIa inhibitors are kept for bail-out in no-reflow or a thrombotic complication, and at 80 they carry a high bleeding risk.

prompt.zh-CN: 血栓抽吸后复查造影：右冠状动脉管壁光滑，未见明显狭窄。血管内超声：内膜完整，未见斑块破裂。她有房颤 5 年，平时没有吃任何防血栓的药。你怎么解释这次闭塞？这条血管要不要放支架？
prompt.en: After aspiration the right coronary artery wall is smooth with no significant stenosis, and intravascular ultrasound shows an intact intima without plaque rupture. She has had AF for five years and takes no blood thinner. How do you explain the occlusion, and does this artery need a stent?

need.zh-CN: 先复查造影、阅读血管内超声，并已问清她的房颤病史和防血栓用药。
need.en: First repeat the angiogram and read the intravascular ultrasound, with her AF history and blood-thinner use established.

text.zh-CN: 很可能是房颤相关的冠状动脉栓塞：没有需要处理的病变，不放支架；开始抗凝，并用超声心动图寻找栓子来源和其他部位的栓塞
text.en: Probable coronary embolism from AF: there is no lesion to treat, so no stent; start anticoagulation and look for the source with echocardiography, and for emboli elsewhere

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。抽吸后管壁光滑、腔内影像未见斑块破裂，加上未抗凝的房颤，可满足 Shibata 等（2015）标准中的 1 项主要和 1 项次要标准，即“很可能”的冠状动脉栓塞；影像上找到栓子来源即可达到“确诊”。没有病变就没有支架指征，也就免去了联合抗栓治疗。IVUS 不能完全排除斑块侵蚀，分辨率更高的 OCT 更合适（ESC 2023 ACS）。
feedback.en: Correct. A smooth wall after aspiration, imaging without plaque rupture and untreated AF can meet one major and one minor Shibata criterion (2015) — probable coronary embolism — and an embolic source on imaging would make it definite. No lesion means no indication for a stent, which spares her combined antithrombotic therapy. IVUS cannot fully exclude plaque erosion; OCT, with its finer resolution, is better suited (ESC 2023 ACS).

text.zh-CN: 血栓下面多半有 IVUS 分辨不出的斑块侵蚀：在原血栓部位置入药物洗脱支架把病变封住，之后双联抗血小板治疗 12 个月
text.en: There is probably plaque erosion beneath, too fine for IVUS to resolve: seal the former thrombus site with a drug-eluting stent, then give 12 months of dual antiplatelet therapy

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。IVUS 确实不能完全排除斑块侵蚀（ESC 2023 ACS 对不确定病变首选 OCT），但管腔通畅、没有明显狭窄时，支架没有可以处理的狭窄；而未抗凝的房颤是更直接的解释。支架加 12 个月双联抗血小板，再叠加她需要的抗凝，出血风险很高（ESC 2024 AF）。
feedback.en: No. IVUS cannot entirely exclude erosion (ESC 2023 ACS prefers OCT for ambiguous lesions), but with a patent lumen and no significant stenosis there is nothing for a stent to treat, and untreated AF is the more direct explanation. A stent with 12 months of dual antiplatelet therapy on top of the anticoagulation she needs carries a high bleeding risk (ESC 2024 AF).

text.zh-CN: 冠状动脉痉挛继发血栓：不放支架，冠状动脉内注射硝酸酯，长期服用钙通道阻滞剂，不需要抗凝
text.en: Coronary spasm with secondary thrombosis: no stent, an intracoronary nitrate now and a calcium-channel blocker long term, with no need for anticoagulation

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。痉挛很少留下这么多血栓，而且她本来就在服钙通道阻滞剂氨氯地平；低血压时冠状动脉内给硝酸酯还可能让血压更低。更关键的是这一解释忽略了未抗凝的房颤——按 ESC 2024 AF 指南，她本来就达到抗凝标准。
feedback.en: No. Spasm rarely leaves this much thrombus, she already takes a calcium-channel blocker (amlodipine), and an intracoronary nitrate in hypotension may push the pressure lower. Above all, this ignores her untreated AF — by ESC 2024 AF she met the threshold for anticoagulation anyway.

text.zh-CN: 自发性冠状动脉夹层伴壁内血肿：停用肝素，不再做任何器械操作，保守治疗
text.en: Spontaneous coronary artery dissection with intramural haematoma: stop the heparin, avoid any further instrumentation and treat conservatively

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。腔内影像显示内膜完整，没有描述内膜片或壁内血肿；自发性冠状动脉夹层多见于中青年女性，而不是 80 岁、未抗凝的房颤患者。停用抗凝会让真正的问题——心腔内的血栓来源——得不到处理（ESC 2023 ACS；ESC 2024 AF）。
feedback.en: No. Imaging showed an intact intima, with no flap or intramural haematoma described, and spontaneous dissection is mainly a disease of younger and middle-aged women, not of an 80-year-old with untreated AF. Stopping anticoagulation leaves the real problem — an intracardiac source — untreated (ESC 2023 ACS; ESC 2024 AF).

prompt.zh-CN: 术后第 3 天（没有置入支架）。经胸超声心动图：左心房增大，左心房游离壁一回声考虑为血栓；下壁、后壁运动减弱；LVEF 55%。到院肌酐 57.3 μmol/L；本病例没有记录她的体重。她 80 岁，高血压 10 年、房颤 5 年，此前未用任何抗栓药。你开始哪种抗栓方案？
prompt.en: Day 3 after the procedure (no stent was placed). The transthoracic echo shows an enlarged left atrium with an echo on its free wall considered to be thrombus, reduced inferior and posterior wall motion and an LVEF of 55%. Admission creatinine was 57.3 μmol/L; her weight is not recorded. She is 80, with ten years of hypertension and five of AF, and took no antithrombotic before. Which antithrombotic plan do you start?

need.zh-CN: 先作答决策 4，做经胸超声心动图，并确认已掌握到院肌酐和她的病史、用药。
need.en: First answer decision 4 and get the transthoracic echocardiogram, with her admission creatinine, history and medicines in hand.

text.zh-CN: 现在开始 DOAC，按说明书定剂量：先称体重、核对肾功能；只有机械瓣或中重度二尖瓣狭窄才改用华法林；没放支架就不用双联抗血小板，加用抗血小板药最多一种且限期
text.en: Start a DOAC now at its label dose after weighing her and checking renal function; warfarin only for a mechanical valve or moderate–severe mitral stenosis; no stent, so no dual antiplatelet therapy, and at most one time-limited antiplatelet

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。高血压加年龄 ≥ 75 岁，她这次事件前的 CHA₂DS₂-VA 评分已 ≥ 3 分，加上心肌梗死和动脉栓塞后至少 6 分；ESC 2024 AF 推荐评分 ≥ 2 分即口服抗凝，除机械瓣或中重度二尖瓣狭窄外首选 DOAC，并按说明书剂量（如阿哌沙班仅在年龄 ≥ 80 岁、体重 ≤ 60 kg、肌酐 ≥ 133 μmol/L 中满足两项时减量）——她的体重没有记录，必须先称重。没有支架就没有双联抗血小板的理由。
feedback.en: Correct. Hypertension and age ≥ 75 already gave her a CHA₂DS₂-VA score of at least 3 before this event, and at least 6 after an infarct and an arterial embolism; ESC 2024 AF recommends oral anticoagulation from a score of 2, a DOAC rather than warfarin unless there is a mechanical valve or moderate–severe mitral stenosis, at its label dose (apixaban is reduced only with two of age ≥ 80, weight ≤ 60 kg and creatinine ≥ 133 μmol/L) — her weight is not recorded, so weigh her. No stent leaves no case for dual antiplatelet therapy.

text.zh-CN: 阿司匹林加氯吡格雷代替抗凝：80 岁用口服抗凝药出血风险太高，这次是心肌梗死，抗血小板才是重点，左心房回声可以以后再复查
text.en: Aspirin plus clopidogrel instead of an anticoagulant: at 80 an anticoagulant bleeds too much, this was a heart attack so antiplatelets are what matter, and the atrial echo can be rechecked later on

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。抗血小板不能替代抗凝：ACTIVE W 研究中，阿司匹林加氯吡格雷预防血管事件不如口服抗凝，大出血并不更少；ESC 2024 AF 不推荐以抗血小板药代替抗凝（Ⅲ类），也不以出血评分作为不抗凝的理由；高龄本身恰恰增加了抗凝所要预防的卒中风险。左心房内的回声更是需要抗凝的理由。
feedback.en: No. Antiplatelets are no substitute: in ACTIVE W, aspirin plus clopidogrel prevented fewer vascular events than oral anticoagulation with no less major bleeding, and ESC 2024 AF advises against antiplatelets as an alternative (class III) and against using a bleeding score to withhold anticoagulation; age itself raises the stroke risk that anticoagulation prevents. The atrial echo is a further reason to anticoagulate, not to wait.

text.zh-CN: 暂时只用阿司匹林，等经食管超声证实左心房血栓后再决定是否抗凝：“考虑血栓”还不是确诊，不该让 80 岁老人为此冒出血风险
text.en: Aspirin alone for now, deciding on anticoagulation only once a transoesophageal echo confirms the thrombus: 'considered thrombus' is not proof, and an 80-year-old should not risk bleeding on less

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。即使不看这处回声，她未抗凝的房颤已经引起动脉栓塞，抗凝指征明确，而单用阿司匹林不能替代抗凝（ESC 2024 AF）。经食管超声、CT 或心脏磁共振有助于鉴别血栓与黏液瘤，但不应推迟抗凝；抗凝数周后复查影像，回声缩小或消失本身就支持血栓。
feedback.en: No. Even setting the echo aside, her untreated AF has already caused an arterial embolism and the indication for anticoagulation is clear, and aspirin alone is no substitute for it (ESC 2024 AF). A transoesophageal echo, CT or cardiac MRI can help tell thrombus from myxoma but should not hold up anticoagulation — a mass that shrinks or vanishes on repeat imaging after weeks of anticoagulation itself supports thrombus.

text.zh-CN: 华法林（目标 INR 2.0–3.0），用肝素过渡到 INR 达标，同时长期加用阿司匹林，两种药一起服用、不设停药时间
text.en: Warfarin to an INR of 2.0–3.0, with heparin until the INR is in range, and aspirin taken alongside it long term, the two together with no stop date

feedback.zh-CN: 不对——这接近本病例记录的做法（华法林加肝素过渡，加阿司匹林；阿司匹林用了多久没有记录）。只有机械瓣或中重度二尖瓣狭窄时华法林才是首选，否则颅内出血更少的 DOAC 优先（ESC 2024 AF）；没有支架却长期在抗凝之外加阿司匹林只增加出血，ESC 2024 AF 不推荐为预防卒中在抗凝之外加用抗血小板药。
feedback.en: No — this is close to what the record shows (warfarin with heparin cover, plus aspirin for an unrecorded time). Warfarin is first choice only with a mechanical valve or moderate–severe mitral stenosis; otherwise a DOAC, with less intracranial bleeding, comes first (ESC 2024 AF). Without a stent, open-ended aspirin on top only adds bleeding, and ESC 2024 AF advises against adding antiplatelets to anticoagulation for stroke prevention.

text.zh-CN: DOAC 加阿司匹林和氯吡格雷三联治疗 12 个月：她既有心肌梗死又有心房内血栓，两方面都要充分覆盖
text.en: A DOAC plus aspirin and clopidogrel for 12 months: she has had both a heart attack and an atrial thrombus, and each needs full cover

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。三联治疗只属于置入支架后的短期：房颤合并 ACS 行 PCI 者默认至多 1 周，之后口服抗凝药加氯吡格雷最多 12 个月（ESC 2023 ACS；ESC 2024 AF）。她没有支架，12 个月三联治疗只会让 80 岁的她承受很高的大出血风险。
feedback.en: No. Triple therapy belongs only to the short period after a stent: for AF with ACS treated by PCI the default is at most a week, then an anticoagulant with clopidogrel for up to 12 months (ESC 2023 ACS; ESC 2024 AF). She has no stent, and 12 months of triple therapy would expose her, at 80, to a very high risk of major bleeding.

text.zh-CN: 问清胸痛何时开始、到院时仍在痛，以及伴随的大汗
text.en: Established when the pain began, that it was still present on arrival and that she was sweating heavily

text.zh-CN: 问清高血压和房颤病史、平时用药、有没有用过防血栓药，以及卒中、出血、过敏和体重
text.en: Asked about her hypertension and AF, her regular medicines and any blood thinner, and about stroke, bleeding, allergies and her weight

text.zh-CN: 测量生命体征、观察面色并听诊双肺
text.en: Took her vital signs, looked at her colour and listened to both lungs

text.zh-CN: 到院即记录并阅读 12 导联心电图和右胸导联
text.en: Recorded and read the 12-lead ECG and the right-sided leads on arrival

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择直接 PCI，实际启动了导管室，且没有溶栓
text.en: Chose primary PCI at the first attempt, actually activated the catheter laboratory and gave no lytic

text.zh-CN: 低血压、右心室受累时没有给硝酸甘油，也没有静脉用美托洛尔
text.en: Gave no GTN and no IV metoprolol to a hypotensive patient with right-ventricular involvement

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即定下保护右心室前负荷的方案，并上监护、暂停降压药、谨慎补液和给予阿司匹林负荷
text.en: Set a preload-protecting plan at the first attempt and acted on it: monitoring, antihypertensives held, cautious fluid and an aspirin load

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择选择性抽吸、在决定支架前先行腔内影像，并给予 PCI 用肝素
text.en: Chose selective aspiration with imaging before any stent decision at the first attempt, and gave heparin for the procedure

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即判断为房颤相关的冠状动脉栓塞，并决定不放支架
text.en: Recognised probable AF-related coronary embolism and decided against a stent at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 没有置入不必要的支架
text.en: Placed no unnecessary stent

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即制订以口服抗凝为核心的方案，实际开始口服抗凝，且没有用抗血小板替代或三联治疗
text.en: Set an anticoagulation-based plan at the first attempt, actually started an oral anticoagulant, and used neither antiplatelets in its place nor triple therapy

text.zh-CN: 用她听得懂的话解释病情和长期抗凝，并确认她理解
text.en: Explained her illness and long-term anticoagulation in words she could follow, and checked she understood

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 良好表现（Calgary–Cambridge：开始接诊、收集信息、解释与计划、结束）：在急诊先自我介绍，承认她的疼痛和害怕，用一两句话说明“心脏的一根血管堵住了，要马上去导管室打通”，回应她“会不会不行了”的担心而不作虚假保证。术后第 3 天先问她已经知道什么、最担心什么，再用通俗的话解释：心房颤动让心脏里很可能长了血块，掉下来的一块堵住了心脏的血管，所以以后要长期吃抗凝药——它和她以前吃的降压药不同，也不同于阿司匹林；说明出血的警示信号（黑便、呕血、尿血、出血止不住、突发剧烈头痛）和漏服怎么办，解释为什么要称体重、查肾功能来定剂量；用复述法确认她听懂，请她提问；不责怪谁以前没有给她抗凝，也不承诺本病例没有记录的结局。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance (Calgary–Cambridge: initiating, gathering, explaining and planning, closing): in the ED, introduces themself, acknowledges her pain and fear, says in a sentence or two that 'one of the heart's blood vessels is blocked and needs opening in the catheter laboratory now', and meets her fear of dying without false reassurance. On day 3, first asks what she already knows and what worries her most, then explains plainly that the irregular heartbeat most likely let a clot form inside the heart, a piece of which blocked a heart artery, so she now needs a long-term blood thinner — different from her blood-pressure tablets and from aspirin; names the bleeding warning signs (black stools, vomiting blood, blood in the urine, bleeding that will not stop, a sudden severe headache) and what to do about a missed dose, and why her weight and kidney function set the dose; checks understanding by teach-back and invites questions; blames no one for the missing anticoagulation and promises no outcome the case does not record.

knowledge.zh-CN: 到院交班（ISBAR）：80岁女性，胸痛 6 小时不缓解，面色苍白、大汗；到院血压 88/62 mmHg，心率 62 次/分；已在急诊抢救区。抢救区床旁有监护除颤仪、心电图机（可加做右胸导联）、抢救车（留置针、常用急救药）和氧气；导管室和介入医生一个电话即可启动，转运时带监护和除颤仪。复述医嘱并完成护理范围内的操作；只报告已经出来的结果，不解读、不诊断。收缩压低于 90 mmHg 时，给硝酸甘油之前会先提出疑问、请医生确认。被问到体重、呼吸频率、血氧饱和度、体温或既往史时，如实说没有记录可报，绝不编造数字。
knowledge.en: Handover on arrival (ISBAR): 80-year-old woman, six hours of unrelieved chest pain, pale and sweating heavily; on arrival BP 88/62 mmHg, heart rate 62/min; now in the ED resus bay. At the bedside: a monitor-defibrillator, the ECG machine (right-sided leads possible), the crash cart (cannulas, emergency drugs) and oxygen; the catheter laboratory and interventional cardiologist are one call away, and the transfer goes on the monitor with the defibrillator. Reads orders back and carries out nursing-scope tasks; reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses. With a systolic pressure under 90 mmHg she questions a GTN order before giving it and asks the doctor to confirm. Asked for weight, respiratory rate, oxygen saturation, temperature or past history, says plainly that nothing is recorded to report — never makes up a number.

name.zh-CN: 常医生（心内科主治医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教（PEARLS），只围绕学员已经拿到的资料提问，例如：“下壁 ST 段抬高时，为什么要加做右胸导联？”“收缩压 88 mmHg、双肺清晰，右心室受累意味着什么？哪些常用药会伤害她？”“为什么这里不选溶栓？”“导丝通过后血栓仍多，常规抽吸和选择性抽吸有什么不同？”“抽吸后管壁光滑，血栓可能从哪里来？IVUS 能排除什么、不能排除什么？”“她的房颤以前有没有抗凝？这次之前她的 CHA₂DS₂-VA 评分是多少？”“DOAC 的剂量要看哪些数据，哪些还缺？”。可以讲解 ESC 2023 ACS、第四版心肌梗死通用定义（2018）、中国 STEMI 指南（2019）和 ESC 2024 AF 的相关原则，Shibata 等（2015）的冠状动脉栓塞诊断标准，以及常规血栓抽吸的证据如何从 ESC 2012 的Ⅱa 类变为 ESC 2023 的Ⅲ类。学员读到结局记录之后，可以把记录中的方案与现行做法对照讨论。不提前说出诊断或任何决策的正确选项；不补充病例中没有的资料（心电图节律、呼吸频率、血氧饱和度、体重、瓣膜、其他冠状动脉、用药剂量、心力衰竭用药和远期结局都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: Socratic preceptor (PEARLS) who asks only about information the learner already has, e.g. “With inferior ST elevation, why add the right-sided leads?”, “A systolic of 88 and clear lungs — what does right-ventricular involvement mean, and which usual drugs could harm her?”, “Why not fibrinolysis here?”, “Heavy thrombus once the wire is across — how is selective aspiration different from routine?”, “A smooth wall after aspiration — where could the thrombus have come from, and what can IVUS not exclude?”, “Was her AF ever anticoagulated, and what was her CHA₂DS₂-VA score before this?”, “Which data set the DOAC dose, and which are missing?”. May explain the relevant principles of ESC 2023 ACS, the Fourth Universal Definition of MI (2018), the Chinese STEMI guideline (2019) and ESC 2024 AF, the Shibata criteria for coronary embolism (2015), and how routine aspiration went from class IIa in ESC 2012 to class III in ESC 2023; once the learner has read the outcome record, may contrast the recorded regimen with current practice. Never states the diagnosis or any decision's correct option before the learner commits, and adds no data the case lacks (the ECG rhythm, respiratory rate, oxygen saturation, weight, valves, the other coronary arteries, doses, heart-failure medicines and the long-term outcome are not recorded).

name.zh-CN: 邵医生（心内科介入医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 介入心内科医生，接到导管室呼叫后参与。只解读学员已经读过的心电图、冠状动脉造影和血管内超声：下壁导联和右胸导联与右冠状动脉的对应关系；大量血栓时选择性抽吸与常规抽吸的区别（TASTE、TOTAL 研究）；为什么在决定支架之前先做腔内影像，IVUS 与 OCT 的分辨率差别；没有病变为什么不放支架。若学员问到血栓在右冠状动脉远段、右胸导联却抬高的问题：右心室支通常发自右冠状动脉近中段，这种组合并不常见，本病例没有记录能解释它的资料——如实说明，不作猜测。不报告学员尚未读到的结果，不提超声心动图；不编造优势型、其他冠状动脉、抽吸后血流分级、抽出物外观或病理、入路和术中用药（都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: Interventional cardiologist who joins once the laboratory is called. Interprets only the ECGs, angiogram and intravascular ultrasound the learner has read: how the inferior and right-sided leads map to the right coronary artery; selective versus routine aspiration for heavy thrombus (TASTE, TOTAL); why to image before deciding on a stent, and how IVUS and OCT differ in resolution; why no lesion means no stent. If asked why the right-sided leads were raised when the thrombus was distal: the right-ventricular branches usually arise from the proximal-to-mid right coronary artery, so the pairing is unusual and the case records nothing that resolves it — say so rather than guess. Never reports a result the learner has not read and never mentions the echocardiogram; never invents dominance, the other coronary arteries, the post-aspiration flow grade, the aspirate's appearance or histology, the access route or procedural drugs (none is recorded).

knowledge.zh-CN: 临床药师，术后第 3 天参与用药讨论。讲解 DOAC 与华法林的选择（只有机械瓣或中重度二尖瓣狭窄才首选华法林，目标 INR 2.0–3.0，用肝素过渡到达标）；各 DOAC 按说明书的剂量依据——年龄、体重、肾功能（计算肌酐清除率需要体重，本病例没有体重）和相互作用；阿哌沙班只在年龄 ≥ 80 岁、体重 ≤ 60 kg、血肌酐 ≥ 133 μmol/L 中满足两项时减量，不超说明书减量；与口服抗凝药合用时 P2Y12 受体抑制剂首选氯吡格雷，替格瑞洛和普拉格雷不用于三联治疗；联合抗栓时考虑质子泵抑制剂；低血压期间暂停降压药。不解读化验和影像，不报告学员没有读到的结果，不编造体重或剂量。
knowledge.en: Clinical pharmacist who joins the medicines discussion on day 3. Explains DOAC versus warfarin (warfarin first only with a mechanical valve or moderate–severe mitral stenosis, INR 2.0–3.0 with heparin until in range); the label basis of each DOAC's dose — age, weight, renal function (creatinine clearance needs a weight, and none is recorded) and interactions; that apixaban is reduced only with two of age ≥ 80, weight ≤ 60 kg and creatinine ≥ 133 μmol/L, with no off-label reduction; that clopidogrel is the P2Y12 inhibitor to pair with an oral anticoagulant, ticagrelor and prasugrel not being used in triple therapy; a proton-pump inhibitor with combined antithrombotic therapy; and holding antihypertensives while she is hypotensive. Does not interpret results or images, reports nothing the learner has not read, and invents no weight or dose.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：低血压的下壁心肌梗死、导管室里的血栓和房颤的抗凝
title.en: Debrief: a hypotensive inferior infarct, a thrombus in the catheter laboratory and anticoagulation in AF

conclusion.zh-CN: 80岁女性，高血压 10 年、房颤 5 年，服培哚普利和氨氯地平，未用抗栓药；胸痛 6 小时不缓解，面色苍白、大汗，到院血压 88/62 mmHg、心率 62 次/分，双肺清晰。心电图Ⅱ、Ⅲ、aVF 导联 ST 段抬高 0.15–0.2 mV，V3R–V5R 抬高 0.1 mV：下壁 ST 段抬高型心肌梗死合并右心室受累和低血压。急诊造影示右冠状动脉远段大量血栓、TIMI 1 级；抽吸后管壁光滑、无明显狭窄，IVUS 内膜完整、无斑块破裂，未放支架。术后第 3 天超声见左心房增大、游离壁回声考虑血栓，下壁和后壁运动减弱，LVEF 55%；肌钙蛋白 I 94.12 μg/L，BNP 3981.2 ng/L。诊断：未抗凝房颤患者左心房血栓栓塞冠状动脉所致急性心肌梗死（很可能，栓子迁移未被直接观察到）。记录中用华法林加肝素过渡（第 6 天 INR 2.3 停肝素）并加阿司匹林，前 10 天心衰症状随后好转。按现行指南：立即直接 PCI，不用硝酸酯，选择性抽吸加腔内影像，不放支架，按说明书剂量使用 DOAC。
conclusion.en: An 80-year-old woman with ten years of hypertension and five of AF, on perindopril and amlodipine but no antithrombotic, had six hours of unrelieved chest pain, pallor and sweating; BP 88/62 mmHg, heart rate 62/min, clear lungs. ST elevation of 0.15–0.2 mV in II, III and aVF and 0.1 mV in V3R–V5R: inferior STEMI with right-ventricular involvement and hypotension. Angiography: heavy distal RCA thrombus, TIMI 1 flow; after aspiration the wall was smooth without significant stenosis and IVUS showed an intact intima; no stent was placed. On day 3 echo showed an enlarged left atrium with a free-wall echo considered thrombus, inferior and posterior hypokinesis and LVEF 55%; troponin I 94.12 μg/L, BNP 3981.2 ng/L. Diagnosis: infarction from probable coronary embolism of left atrial thrombus in untreated AF. She received warfarin, heparin until INR 2.3 on day 6, and aspirin. Today: immediate primary PCI, no nitrate, selective aspiration with imaging, no stent, and a DOAC at its label dose.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 6 小时不缓解的胸痛伴Ⅱ、Ⅲ、aVF 导联 ST 段抬高，就是 12 小时窗内的下壁 ST 段抬高型心肌梗死：要做的是立即直接 PCI，而不是等肌钙蛋白、先做 CT 或溶栓。
keyReasoning.en: Six hours of unrelieved pain with ST elevation in II, III and aVF is an inferior STEMI inside the 12-hour window: the act is immediate primary PCI, not a troponin wait, a CT or a lytic.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 下壁抬高就要看右胸导联：V3R–V5R 抬高 0.1 mV、收缩压 88 mmHg、双肺清晰，描述的是依赖前负荷的右心室——所以不用硝酸酯、利尿剂和静脉 β 受体阻滞剂，暂停降压药，谨慎补液。
keyReasoning.en: Inferior elevation sends you to the right-sided leads: 0.1 mV in V3R–V5R with a systolic of 88 mmHg and clear lungs describes a preload-dependent right ventricle — hence no nitrate, diuretic or IV beta-blocker, antihypertensives held and fluid given cautiously.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 大量血栓、TIMI 1 级时选择性抽吸是合理的；在决定支架之前看清血管壁，才能知道下面有没有需要处理的病变。
keyReasoning.en: Heavy thrombus with TIMI 1 flow invites selective aspiration; seeing the wall before any stent decision is what tells you whether there is a lesion to treat.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 抽吸后管壁光滑、无明显狭窄、无斑块破裂，再加上未抗凝的房颤，问题就从“哪块斑块破了”变成“血栓从哪里来”：按 Shibata 标准很可能是冠状动脉栓塞，超声找到左心房来源后可达确诊。
keyReasoning.en: A smooth wall without significant stenosis or plaque rupture after aspiration, in untreated AF, turns the question from 'which plaque?' to 'where did the clot come from?' — coronary embolism, probable by the Shibata criteria and definite once the echo shows a left atrial source.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 没有病变就没有支架，也就没有双联抗血小板的理由；处理栓子来源靠抗凝，药物和剂量按房颤指南选择——而她在这次事件之前就已符合抗凝标准。
keyReasoning.en: No lesion means no stent and no reason for dual antiplatelet therapy; the embolic source is treated with anticoagulation, chosen and dosed by the AF guidance — which she qualified for before this event.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单篇病例报告，本版依据 1.0.0 版提取的事实改写，尚未对照原文全文核对。它不能证明栓子就来自左心房那处回声（栓子迁移没有被直接观察到），不能说明这类回声有多少是血栓而不是肿瘤，也不能说明早些抗凝能避免什么。心电图节律、其他生命体征、体重、瓣膜、其他冠状动脉、药物剂量和远期结局都没有记录；决策、处置选项和评分是教学设计，不改变记录的病程。
boundaries.en: A single case report, re-authored here from the facts extracted for version 1.0.0 and not yet checked against the full article. It cannot prove that the embolus came from the atrial echo (its migration was not observed), say how often such an echo is thrombus rather than tumour, or show what earlier anticoagulation would have prevented. The ECG rhythm, other vital signs, weight, valves, the other coronary arteries, drug doses and the long-term outcome are not recorded; the decisions, intervention options and scoring are teaching design and do not change the recorded course.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 下壁 ST 段抬高型心肌梗死中的右心室受累。每例下壁 STEMI 都要记录右胸导联（中国 STEMI 指南 2019）：V3R/V4R 导联 ST 段抬高 ≥ 0.05 mV（30 岁以下男性 ≥ 0.1 mV）支持右心室梗死（第四版心肌梗死通用定义，ESC/ACC/AHA/WHF 2018）。收缩压 < 90 mmHg、双肺清晰时，右心室依赖前负荷：低血压或右心室梗死时不用硝酸酯（ESC 2023 ACS），要维持右心室前负荷、避免利尿剂和扩血管药（中国 STEMI 指南 2019），暂停降压药，小剂量分次补液并复评，警惕心动过缓和房室传导阻滞，尽快再灌注。记录与现行做法：记录给出了到院血压、右胸导联和双肺清晰，但没有记录急诊期间的处理。
teachingPoints.en: Right-ventricular involvement in inferior STEMI. Record the right-sided leads in every inferior STEMI (Chinese STEMI guideline 2019): ST elevation of ≥ 0.05 mV in V3R/V4R (≥ 0.1 mV in men under 30) supports RV infarction (Fourth Universal Definition of MI, ESC/ACC/AHA/WHF 2018). With a systolic pressure below 90 mmHg and clear lungs the right ventricle is preload-dependent: no nitrate with hypotension or RV infarction (ESC 2023 ACS); keep the preload up and avoid diuretics and vasodilators (Chinese STEMI guideline 2019); hold antihypertensives, give small fluid boluses with reassessment, watch for bradycardia and AV block, and reperfuse at once. Then and now: the record gives the arrival pressure, the right-sided leads and clear lungs, but no ED treatment.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 80 岁同样直接 PCI。ESC 2023 ACS：发病 12 小时内的 STEMI，能在诊断后 120 分钟内完成时直接 PCI 优于溶栓；阿司匹林 150–300 mg 负荷，PCI 时普通肝素 70–100 U/kg；再灌注不等肌钙蛋白，高龄本身不是禁忌。预计需要口服抗凝时（如未抗凝的房颤），P2Y12 受体抑制剂选氯吡格雷（负荷 300–600 mg）。中国 STEMI 指南（2019）的优先次序相同。
teachingPoints.en: Primary PCI at 80 as at any age. ESC 2023 ACS: STEMI within 12 hours of onset gets primary PCI in preference to fibrinolysis when it can be done within 120 minutes of diagnosis; aspirin 150–300 mg loading and unfractionated heparin 70–100 U/kg at PCI; reperfusion does not wait for troponin, and age alone is no contraindication. When oral anticoagulation is foreseeable — as in untreated AF — choose clopidogrel (300–600 mg loading) as the P2Y12 inhibitor. The Chinese STEMI guideline (2019) sets the same priorities.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 血栓抽吸的过去与现在。ESC 2012 STEMI 指南曾把常规抽吸列为Ⅱa 类；TASTE（2013）未见死亡率获益，TOTAL（2015）未见获益且 30 天卒中更多，ESC 2023 ACS 现将常规抽吸列为Ⅲ类（A 级），2025 年 ACC/AHA ACS 指南同样认为无获益。导丝通过后仍有大量血栓时选择性抽吸属于临床判断——正如本例记录，抽吸后行 IVUS。腔内影像可指导 ACS 的 PCI；罪犯病变不确定时首选 OCT，因为 IVUS 不能排除斑块侵蚀（ESC 2023 ACS）。
teachingPoints.en: Thrombus aspiration, then and now. ESC 2012 STEMI rated routine aspiration class IIa; TASTE (2013) showed no mortality benefit and TOTAL (2015) no benefit with more strokes at 30 days, so ESC 2023 ACS rates routine aspiration class III (level A), and the 2025 ACC/AHA ACS guideline likewise finds no benefit. Selective aspiration for a heavy residual thrombus burden remains a judgement — as in this record, where it was followed by IVUS. Intravascular imaging guides PCI in ACS, and for an ambiguous culprit OCT is preferred because IVUS cannot exclude plaque erosion (ESC 2023 ACS).

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 冠状动脉栓塞。Shibata 等（2015）的主要标准：造影见无动脉粥样硬化成分的栓塞或血栓、多处冠状动脉同时栓塞、伴发全身栓塞；次要标准：其他血管狭窄 < 25%、经胸或经食管超声、CT 或磁共振见栓子来源、存在栓塞危险因素（如房颤）。≥ 2 项主要、1 项主要加 ≥ 2 项次要或 3 项次要为确诊，1 项主要加 1 项次要或 2 项次要为很可能；房颤是最常见的病因。房颤血栓大多位于左心耳，经胸超声容易漏诊，游离壁上的回声并不典型——需要经食管超声、CT 或心脏磁共振，或抗凝后复查看是否缩小来与黏液瘤鉴别，并寻找其他部位的栓塞。
teachingPoints.en: Coronary embolism. The Shibata criteria (2015): major — angiographic embolism or thrombosis without atherosclerotic components, simultaneous emboli in several coronary sites, concomitant systemic embolism; minor — < 25 % stenosis in the other vessels, an embolic source on TTE, TEE, CT or MRI, embolic risk factors such as AF. Definite with ≥ 2 major, 1 major + ≥ 2 minor or 3 minor; probable with 1 major + 1 minor or 2 minor; AF is the commonest cause. Most AF thrombi form in the left atrial appendage, which transthoracic echo easily misses, and an echo on the free wall is atypical — a transoesophageal echo, CT or cardiac MRI, or shrinkage on repeat imaging under anticoagulation, separates thrombus from myxoma; look for emboli elsewhere too.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 栓塞性心肌梗死后的抗凝。ESC 2024 AF 以 CHA₂DS₂-VA 取代 CHA₂DS₂-VASc：评分 ≥ 2 分推荐口服抗凝——她在这次事件前至少 3 分（高血压 1 分、年龄 ≥ 75 岁 2 分），事件后至少 6 分（加血管疾病 1 分、动脉血栓栓塞 2 分）。除机械瓣或中重度二尖瓣狭窄外，DOAC 优于维生素 K 拮抗剂，按说明书剂量（阿哌沙班仅在年龄 ≥ 80 岁、体重 ≤ 60 kg、肌酐 ≥ 133 μmol/L 中满足两项时用 2.5 mg 每日 2 次）；抗血小板药不能替代抗凝（Ⅲ类；ACTIVE W），出血评分用来发现可纠正的出血危险因素，而不是拒绝抗凝的理由。
teachingPoints.en: Anticoagulation after an embolic infarct. ESC 2024 AF replaces CHA₂DS₂-VASc with CHA₂DS₂-VA and recommends oral anticoagulation from a score of 2 — she had at least 3 before this event (hypertension 1, age ≥ 75 2) and at least 6 after it (vascular disease 1, arterial thromboembolism 2). A DOAC is preferred to a vitamin K antagonist except with a mechanical valve or moderate–severe mitral stenosis, at its label dose (apixaban 2.5 mg twice daily only with two of age ≥ 80, weight ≤ 60 kg, creatinine ≥ 133 μmol/L); antiplatelets are no alternative (class III; ACTIVE W), and bleeding scores identify correctable risks rather than reasons to withhold.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 抗栓方案的过去与现在。记录中的做法是华法林、肝素过渡到第 6 天 INR 2.3 时停用，再加阿司匹林（疗程未记录）——这是 2014 年报告中的方案。现在，没有机械瓣或中重度二尖瓣狭窄时首选 DOAC；没有支架就没有双联抗血小板；心肌梗死后若加一种抗血小板药（首选氯吡格雷）要限定疗程，12 个月后单用抗凝（ESC 2023 ACS；ESC 2024 AF）。DOAC 有禁忌时华法林仍然正确：目标 INR 2.0–3.0，肝素用到 INR 达标。
teachingPoints.en: The antithrombotic plan, then and now. The record shows warfarin, heparin until the INR reached 2.3 on day 6, plus aspirin for an unrecorded time — a regimen reported in 2014. Today, without a mechanical valve or moderate–severe mitral stenosis, a DOAC comes first; no stent means no dual antiplatelet therapy; if one antiplatelet (preferably clopidogrel) is added after the infarct it is time-limited, and the anticoagulant continues alone after 12 months (ESC 2023 ACS; ESC 2024 AF). Warfarin is still right when a DOAC is contraindicated: INR 2.0–3.0, with heparin until it is in range.
